builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Aatrox: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A spell-driven melee fighter who controls spacing with repeated knockups and sustains through champion damage. Weaving the periodic empowered attack matters alongside landing Q edges. Do Q sweet spots and the periodic empowered attack repay an AD/haste core before health-to-AD purchases become worthwhile? Record healing under Grievous Wounds and missed Q edges. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Aatrox: Do Q sweet spots and the periodic empowered attack repay an AD/haste core before health-to-AD purchases become worthwhile? Record healing under Grievous Wounds and missed Q edges.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Blood Well. Do not treat mana regeneration as Blood Well recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

The route fails Aatrox's stated kit question: Do Q sweet spots and the periodic empowered attack repay an AD/haste core before health-to-AD purchases become worthwhile? Record healing under Grievous Wounds and missed Q edges.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Blood Well. Do not treat mana regeneration as Blood Well recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for [3] seconds and gaining [(0.6 / 0.8 / 1) × 100]% Move Speed decaying over [10] seconds. He also gains [(0.2 / 0.3 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by [(0.5 / 0.75 / 1) × 100]% for the duration.

Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by [5] seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect.

Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing [10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD] physical damage. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly Knocked Up and they take [(10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD) × ((1 + 0.75))] instead. This Ability can be Recast twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.

Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(0.04 → 0.1; raw flags preserved)] max Health magic damage and restore [100]% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to [25]% against minions. This effect has a [characterLevelInterpolation(22 → 10; raw flags preserved)] second cooldown.

Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.

Aatrox fires a chain, Slowing the first enemy hit by [(-0.25 / -0.275 / -0.3 / -0.325 / -0.35) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds and dealing [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70 + (0.4) × AD] physical damage. Champions and large jungle monsters have [1.5] seconds to leave the impact area or be Pulled back to the center and damaged again for the same amount.

Passive: Aatrox heals for [(16 + (0.013) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)] of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.

builds.name: Bloodmail edge sustain
builds.summary: Test bloodmail edge sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test bloodmail edge sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: The Darkin Blade's 0.6-0.9 AD ratio and 75% edge bonus let Bloodmail's health-to-AD feed spell damage; World Ender amplifies AD and self-healing, while Sundered Sky rewards the attack between casts.
testPlan: Required state: Land Q edges and one attack before disengaging.
Compare three edge hits and healing over ten seconds at equal gold.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: W escape and healing reduction break the loop.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Health never grants unlimited healing; E Stat(12)[statFormula=2] needs mapping.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
